title: Marex launches global payments platform
summary: Marex reaches a key milestone in Global Payments, progressing its cross-border payments offering for banks, corporates and institutional clients worldwide.
body_markdown:
Marex has launched its global payments platform following authorization from the UK Financial Conduct Authority to provide payment services.


Over the past year, Marex has developed a global payments platform designed to provide fast, secure and transparent cross-border payments in more than 150 currencies. The platform builds on Marex’s institutional FX expertise, combining FX pricing with payment processing and routing technology, and is designed to support payments in both fiat and digital currencies.


## Flexible connectivity for different client needs


Marex’s global payments platform has been designed around the different ways clients interact with payments infrastructure.


The new business will serve banks, corporates and institutional trading clients. For banks, it will provide access to international payment capabilities, including in emerging and frontier markets, with end-to-end payment tracking.


For corporates, it will extend Marex’s existing FX, treasury and investment offering to include international payments, while providing institutional trading clients with an additional service alongside their existing relationship with the Group.


## Connecting clients to cross-border payment rails


The global payments offering gives clients one connection to local payment rails across markets, with Marex providing the infrastructure behind the payment. Clients no longer have to manage banking relationships market by market.


At the heart of the global payments offering is a purpose-built platform supported by Marex’s specialist teams. Designed to simplify the complexities of cross-border payments, it enables financial institutions and corporates to move money across markets with greater speed, transparency and control. Its flexible architecture supports continuous innovation as payment technologies, client expectations and market infrastructure evolve.


The offering is being developed to reduce the operational complexity associated with cross-border payments while giving clients greater flexibility over how payments are initiated, processed and tracked.


Embedded compliance controls will support payment flows, including KYC orchestration, AML and sanctions screening, fraud detection and transaction monitoring.


The global payments offering is also being developed with a particular focus on frontier markets, where navigating multiple currencies, banking relationships and local payment infrastructure can create additional complexity.


## Extending Marex’s foreign exchange capabilities


Global Payments will build on Marex’s broader foreign exchange business, which provides 24-hour access to G20 and emerging market currencies alongside specialist expertise in frontier markets.


Marex supports clients across electronic execution, corporate hedging and institutional FX, with capabilities spanning spot, forwards, swaps, options and bespoke FX solutions.


Global Payments will extend this proposition across more of the transaction lifecycle, bringing together FX execution, settlement and onward payment through a single Marex relationship.


Greg Tsimbler,


Deputy CEO of Capital Markets and Global Head of FX & Payments


at Marex, said:


*“Global payments represent a significant growth opportunity, and we believe the market is ready for a new technology-led provider combining strong financial infrastructure, institutional FX capabilities and robust compliance controls.* *For our corporate clients it expands our offering beyond FX hedging, treasury and investment services to include international payments. It also creates a significant opportunity to support banks and existing institutional clients with secure and efficient cross-border payments in more than 150 currencies.”*


Carsten Hils and Prashant Joshi, Co-Heads of Global Payments at Marex, said:


*“This is an important milestone for Marex as we expand our payments capabilities and bring a new service to market. We want to give clients flexible ways to connect with cross-border payment infrastructure, bringing together FX pricing, payment processing and access to different payment rails through a single Marex relationship.”*


## Building out global payments


With this milestone reached, Marex is progressing the operational infrastructure required to make global payments available to clients.


Marex plans to continue expanding the reach and functionality of the offering, with a roadmap to support payments across more currencies and countries.


The roadmap includes further development of connectivity, payment tracking and additional services, informed by client requirements and availability across individual markets.


The global payments offering forms part of Marex’s broader investment in


infrastructure and specialist expertise


and its ambition to support clients across more of the journey from FX execution through settlement to payment.
